description: Sign-randomization inference on 16 event-level log(RR) values
method: For each of 100,000 iterations, randomly flip the sign of each event log(RR), compute geometric mean RR. Tests whether the observed magnitude+direction pattern is unlikely under the null of no directional SSW effect.
interpretation: The sign-randomization P=0.00053 for gmRR incorporates both magnitude and direction information. Even after worst-case Bonferroni correction for 20 candidate hypotheses, P_adj=0.011 survives alpha=0.05 two-sided. This resolves the exploratory-origin Bonferroni concern.
